name: GT2 smooth idler, 3 mm bore (generic)
summary: 3 mm bore, 16 mm flanges and an 8 mm belt channel.
source: Generic flanged idler for a 6 mm-wide GT2 belt. Chosen flange diameter 16 mm, overall width 10 mm, two 1 mm lips and 3 mm through bore. No common standard fixes these envelopes; measure the bought idler. Bearings and bearing shields are visual simplifications.
